faq.label: faq
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.description: Quick answers about how we work.

items.question: What does PanDEVbono do?
items.answer: We design and develop websites and apps — for the web, mobile (Android, iOS) and desktop (Windows, macOS, Linux) — deploy them on AWS, Google Cloud and Cloudflare, and set up and manage the AI tools your team uses.

items.question: Do you build mobile and desktop apps?
items.answer: Yes. We build apps for Android and iOS, and desktop apps for Windows, macOS and Linux. We are open to any kind of app — tell us what you need and we will choose the best approach, native or cross-platform.

items.question: What does AI tools management include?
items.answer: Choosing the right tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, GitHub Copilot, Cursor and others), setting up accounts and access, integrating AI models into your apps and data, defining usage and security policies, and keeping an eye on cost.

items.question: Which cloud platforms do you work with?
items.answer: We work with Amazon Web Services (AWS) and Google Cloud Platform (GCP), and use Cloudflare for DNS, CDN, Workers and protection at the edge.

items.question: Which technologies do you work with?
items.answer: We have experience with React, Next.js, Angular, Node.js, Ruby on Rails, Firebase, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis and Elasticsearch, among others. Today the specific language or framework matters less than the result, so we choose the right stack for each project and can work with any technology you already use.

items.question: Do you work in Spanish and English?
items.answer: Yes. We work with clients in both Spanish and English.

items.question: How do I start a project with you?
items.answer: Email us at pan.dev.bono@gmail.com with a short description of your idea and we will get back to you.
